Hi Markus / Priya / team,

Thanks again for the quick intake call this morning. To keep momentum and make sure the right folks (SRE + security + procurement) can join, I sketched three short demo windows we can rotate across the next two weeks. Each window is 60 minutes (30m demo + 30m Q&A / procurement ops). See the attached Agenda_v1.pdf.

Window options (all times shown with conversions):
- Option A (US-friendly): Tue 25 May 07:00 PDT / 16:00 CEST / 22:00 SGT
- Option B (EU-friendly): Wed 26 May 15:00 PDT / 00:00 CEST (Thu) / 08:00 SGT (Thu)
- Option C (APAC-friendly): Thu 27 May 23:00 PDT / 08:00 CEST (Fri) / 15:00 SGT (Fri)

Request: please reply with the single option that works best for your core attendees (SRE, security, procurement). If none of these work, reply with a 1–2 hour range and we’ll map alternatives.

Quick notes:
- We plan to include a short smoke-test/proof-of-concept checklist (Tech-Checklist.xlsx) for the SEs to run after the session.
- If procurement needs a separate PO/contract sync, include procurement@aldeadata.com in replies — we can either do a short call afterward or attach the contract template in advance.

Thanks,

Lauren — quick technical note / availability from the SE side.

All three windows work for me for a light demo; my preference is Option A or B because they avoid very late SGT hours for our engineers. If we pick Option A (07:00 PDT / 16:00 CEST / 22:00 SGT) I’ll plan to:

- Reserve the last 30 minutes for security/procurement-specific questions + next steps
